# r2 script menus: m05_contest (generated by gen.py; edit gen.py, not this file)
# Each menu: a RAM script at the call site's x,y with that site's message; every row snapped.
# Battle-room menus are drawn in their facility's lobby (the battle rooms run map scripts on entry).
start saves/r2menus_postgame.sav
include ../continue.txt
# the save has never entered the Frontier: skip the Reception Gate's first-visit scene
ev setvar VAR_HAS_ENTERED_BATTLE_FRONTIER, 1; end

# contest_info  (data/scripts/contest_hall.inc:74)
warptoloose MAP_LILYCOVE_CITY_CONTEST_LOBBY_HNS 14 11
waitnotask map_name_popup:Task_MapNamePopUpWindow 600
evstart lockall; message 0x@LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhichTopic1@; waitmessage; multichoice 0, 0, MULTI_CONTEST_INFO, FALSE; closemessage; releaseall; end
talk contest_info_m 40 - Task_HandleMultichoiceInput
snap contest_info_r1
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 1 DOWN
snap contest_info_r2
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 2 DOWN
snap contest_info_r3
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 3 DOWN
snap contest_info_r4
tap B 0
waitctl 900
